requirements: R1: dedupe returns the events with every repeated id removed, keeping the first occurrence
R2: the output preserves first-seen order of ids
risks: dedupe.dedupe: medium — duplicate delivery is normal for event pipelines
invariants: I1: no id appears twice in the output
I2: output order equals first-seen input order

criteria.evidence: dedupe.py:5-7 appends only on first sight of an id; test_dedupe.py:14-15 asserts ids [1, 2]
dedupe.py:4-7 single ordered pass, append-only; order asserted at test_dedupe.py:15 and :23 (inputs already ascending — see notes)

selection_reasons.invariants: trigger: duplicate delivery / idempotency / ordering invariant named in the task

checks_executed.command_or_inspection: invariants reviewer boundary table (I1, I2, empty, all-duplicates, None id, generator input)
checks_executed.result: all hold by inspection of dedupe.py:1-8
no-dedupe, whole-dict dedupe, reverse-walk caught; sort-by-id and keep-last-payload NOT caught

findings.claim: Every test input is already in ascending id order, so an implementation that sorts output by id passes the whole suite; first-seen order (R2/I2) is asserted only on inputs where it coincides with sorted order (merged with acceptance-1 and invariants-1)
evidence: dedupe.py:4-7 is correct: single ordered pass
findings.failure_mechanism: a later change to sorted(out, key=id) -> suite stays green -> event history reordered undetected

findings.claim: No assertion pins which duplicate's payload is kept, so a keep-last implementation (dict overwrite) passes; the 'keeps the first event' part of A1 is unproven (merged with acceptance-2 and invariants-2)
evidence: test_dedupe.py:14-15 assert only length and id list; value 'a' vs 'a-again' (lines 9, 11) never asserted
findings.failure_mechanism: switch to list({e['id']: e for e in events}.values()) -> returns value 'a-again' for id 1 -> suite stays green

minimum_next_action: none required; recommended: add a test with a non-sorted input (e.g. ids [3,1,2,1] -> [3,1,2]) and assert result[0]['value'] == 'a'
